comparison.objective: Commission a shock absorber vs unpack a supported optical instrument onto a service stand.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine fastening, collar adjustment, socket reacquisition, and guarded cycling vs support-preserving extraction, cap/cradle handling, and stable placement.
comparison.success_condition: Two non-bottoming, force-bounded stops with retained setting vs instrument placed and released without excessive tilt/drop, with packing parts in the tray.
comparison.reason: Safe support transfer of a fragile instrument is materially different from tuning and locking an energy absorber.
